title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated August 20, 2026 relative to the Memorandum of Understanding
text:
[5. REGULAR AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated August 20, 2026 relative to the Memorandum of Understanding
  Between the City of Los Angeles and Axon Enterprise, Inc. for the Lightpost Test Pilot Program.
  [BPC #26-258]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: Approval of Memorandum of Understanding between City of Los Angeles and Axon Enterprise for Lightpost surveillance technology pilot program.
